src directory: contains audio files in PCM format
mp3 directory: contains audio files in mp3 format
opus directory: contains audio files encoded in opus format
speex directory: contains audio files in speex format

Please select the required audio format and copy the files to the SDK

CI130X SDK audio storage path : .\projects\*_sample\firmware\voice\src\
CI11XX SDK audio storage path : .\sample\internal\sample_11XX\firmware\voice\[0]voice\
